Paper title: Damage Propagation Modeling for Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Simulation
Plain-language summary: Describes simulated turbofan degradation data used for prognostics research.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Use the dataset as simulated historical trajectories; Kafka replay is not live engine telemetry.
How to use in our project: Foundational dataset; not an ML novelty.

Paper title: Ensemble of Data-Driven Prognostic Algorithms for Robust Prediction of Remaining Useful Life
Plain-language summary: Studies combining prognostic models for more robust RUL estimates.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Ensembling is established; compare fixed/static combination and avoid claiming combination alone is new.

Paper title: Ensemble Learning for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Describes degradation-dependent weighting of predictors for RUL.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Degradation-aware weighting already has precedent; our exact gate must be compared directly against it conceptually and, where details permit, experimentally.

Paper title: A Systematic Literature Review of Machine Learning Methods Applied to Predictive Maintenance
Plain-language summary: Reviews machine-learning approaches used in predictive maintenance.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Frame the project as a workflow including data and evaluation, not only an algorithm.

Paper title: Big Data and Stream Processing Platforms for Industry 4.0 Requirements Mapping for a Predictive Maintenance Use Case
Plain-language summary: Maps streaming and processing platforms to Industry 4.0 predictive-maintenance needs.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Kafka/Spark alone are not novelty; measure throughput, latency, correctness and resources.

Paper title: Predictive Maintenance System for Production Lines in Manufacturing: A Machine Learning Approach Using IoT Data in Real-Time
Plain-language summary: Uses real-time manufacturing IoT information for predictive maintenance.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: End-to-end sensor-stream systems already exist; our benchmark replay and RUL protocol are different but simulated.

Paper title: Challenges of Machine Learning-Based RUL Prognosis: A Review on NASA’s C-MAPSS Data Set
Plain-language summary: Reviews challenges and methodological variation in C-MAPSS prognosis.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Report all four FD subsets and make target/preprocessing choices explicit.

Paper title: A Deep Learning Model for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Aircraft Turbofan Engine on C-MAPSS Dataset
Plain-language summary: Uses data preparation and an LSTM-based approach on C-MAPSS.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Preprocessing and RUL label choices affect comparison; use a declared common protocol.

Paper title: Domain Adaptive Remaining Useful Life Prediction With Transformer
Plain-language summary: Uses transformer-based modelling with adaptation across differing data distributions.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: FD subsets differ in operating conditions and fault modes; report per-subset robustness without claiming to solve domain adaptation.

Paper title: Trend Attention Fully Convolutional Network for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
Plain-language summary: Uses sensor/temporal attention to model useful degradation trends.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Temporal feature selection and explainability pre-exist; our tree features must justify accuracy and cost empirically.

Paper title: A Gated Graph Convolutional Network with Multi-Sensor Signals for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Models sensor relationships and temporal information, with probabilistic/interval-oriented prediction work.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Do not call expert disagreement calibrated uncertainty.

Paper title: PAOLTransformer: Pruning-Adaptive Optimal Lightweight Transformer Model for Aero-Engine RUL Prediction
Plain-language summary: Studies reducing Transformer cost while preserving prediction performance.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Measure model size and inference costs as well as prediction error.

Paper title: Stacking-Based Ensemble Learning for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
Plain-language summary: Studies a learned meta-combination for RUL estimation.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Standard stacking is an essential comparator for our adaptive gate.

Paper title: A Dual Attention LSTM Lightweight Model Based on Exponential Smoothing for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Combines sequential modelling and attention while considering model efficiency.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: A simpler tree-expert method should be evaluated rather than assumed to be superior.

Paper title: An Attention-Based Temporal Convolutional Network Method for Predicting Remaining Useful Life of Aero-Engine
Plain-language summary: Uses temporal modelling and attention for RUL.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Temporal dependence is well studied; compare practical quality and computational overhead.

Paper title: Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction for Predictive Maintenance in Manufacturing
Plain-language summary: Compares practical ML approaches on manufacturing data.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Supports testing classical models, but results from another dataset cannot prove C-MAPSS performance.

Paper title: An Ensembled Remaining Useful Life Prediction Method with Data Fusion and Stage Division
Plain-language summary: Combines sensor/data fusion, degradation stages and ensemble prediction in machinery prognostics.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Stage-aware fusion exists in adjacent domains; justify what the C-MAPSS/tree-expert implementation adds.

Paper title: Dynamic Predictive Maintenance Strategy for System RUL Prediction via Deep Learning Ensemble Method
Plain-language summary: Connects ensemble RUL prediction to maintenance decisions.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: A decision layer is supporting work; priority thresholds need stated assumptions.

Paper title: An Attention-Based Multi-Scale Temporal Convolutional Network for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Combines multiple temporal scales and attention in a neural model.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Multiple temporal scales alone are not novel; our candidate distinction is a separate, transparent gate across tree experts.

Paper title: A Global Attention Based Gated Temporal Convolutional Network for Machine Remaining Useful Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Uses gated temporal convolution and global attention for longer-term degradation patterns.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Degradation context is known; test each contextual gate input through ablation.

Paper title: Remaining Useful Life Estimation Based on Improved Attention Mechanism
Plain-language summary: Uses enhanced attention features for RUL on C-MAPSS and bearing data.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: The project should focus on auditable model combination, not claim degradation-aware modelling is new.

Paper title: Smart Factory: A Real-Time Predictive Maintenance Platform Based on Microservices Architecture and Deep Learning
Plain-language summary: Describes a Kafka-connected microservices platform with C-MAPSS-based deep RUL models.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: A first Kafka+C-MAPSS claim is not tenable; distinguish through the adaptive classical-ML gate, all-subset evaluation and explicit system measurements.

Paper title: Remaining Useful Life Prediction Based on Deep Learning: A Survey
Plain-language summary: Surveys CNN, RNN/LSTM and other deep-learning methods for RUL.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Use as a map of approaches; do not compare headline scores without harmonized protocols.

Paper title: A Review on Physics-Informed Data-Driven Remaining Useful Life Prediction: Challenges and Opportunities
Plain-language summary: Reviews combining physical knowledge and data-driven RUL modelling.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: The current project is data-driven, not physics-informed; note this boundary clearly.

Paper title: A Multi-Model Stacked Ensemble Architecture with Bayesian Optimization: Advancing Remaining Useful Life Estimation in Aircraft Engines
Plain-language summary: Uses stacking and Bayesian optimization for C-MAPSS RUL.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Another reason to compare with stacking; do not treat model count as novelty.

Paper title: Ensemble Learning Based Convolutional Neural Networks for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Aircraft Engines
Plain-language summary: Combines convolutional predictors for C-MAPSS RUL.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Ensemble architecture already exists; compare the exact combination mechanism and cost.

Paper title: A CM&CP Framework with a GIACC Method and an Ensemble Model for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Uses similarity-based grouping plus an accuracy-weighted ensemble.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Accuracy-based weighting is prior art; include a validation-error-weighted baseline.

Paper title: Long Short-Term Memory for Machine Remaining Life Prediction
Plain-language summary: Uses LSTM sequence modelling for remaining-life prediction.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Foundational sequence-model comparator; optional if time permits.

Paper title: Long Short-Term Memory Network for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
Plain-language summary: Introduces LSTM for learning sequential RUL patterns.
Implication / limitation for DARE-RUL: Sequence learning is established; not our main novelty.
